scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Kotlin client conforming to com.google.firebase:firebase-storage via Pyric WebSocket bridge and HTTP byte-route transport. Covers FirebaseStorage instance & bucket factories, StorageReference hierarchy & URL parsing, byte/stream/file UploadTask operations, getBytes/getFile/getStream downloads, tokenized download URLs, StorageMetadata inspection & patching, object deletion, listAll & cursor-paginated list, task lifecycle (pause/resume/cancel & taskState Flow), and Storage Security Rules & App Check enforcement.
